Working solution for JPG files: Read raw bytes with open(file,'rb').read(), encode with base64.b64encode(), call Claude API at http://127.0.0.1:18765/v1/messages with model=claude-opus-4-8 using headers x-api-key and anthropic-version='2023-06-01'. PDF processing blocker: PDF files cannot be processed with the manual base64 approach because Claude API expects image formats (JPEG). PDF files need to be rendered to images first, which typically requires PIL/pdf2image/similar libraries that are not available in this environment. May need to skip PDF files or find alternative approach.
